items.title: Under dualizing-complex, principal-ideal and depth-dimension hypotheses the completion functor on finite locally free sheaves is an equivalence

items.difficulty_reason: The retained proof carries essential surjectivity in full: given a finite locally free object (F_n) of Coh(U, fO_U), it produces a coherent F on U via Lemma algebraization-principal-bis or Proposition cd-1, checks the only missing hypothesis (the (2,3)-inequalities) by citing Lemma unwinding-conditions-bis, then upgrades F to finite locally free on an open neighbourhood of U_0 by comparing stalk completions with finite free modules. Fully faithfulness is delegated to Lemma fully-faithful-general with the delegation named; the load-bearing half of the equivalence is in the span. Retained author proof at lines 8115-8131.
